description: The asset's price over time as points (ms timestamp, price in QU, and for recently recorded points the best bid, ask and pool price). Points before 'recordedSince' were rebuilt from past trades as hourly volume-weighted averages (marked src 'trades'); after it QMax recorded the price about every 10 minutes. OHLC and volume are in qmax_get_candles.

asset.description: Asset symbol, for example CFB or QDOGE (case does not matter). qmax_list_assets lists the tradable symbols.

range.description: How far back to look. 'all' is everything QMax has (about six months).

name: qmax_get_price_history
title: Price over time (line)
